scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate
scripts.checkbeauty: npm run checkbeauty:frontend && npm run checkbeauty:backend
scripts.beautify: npm run beautify:frontend && npm run beautify:backend
scripts.checkbeauty:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run prettier:check
scripts.checkbeauty:backend: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run prettier:check
scripts.beautify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run prettier:write
scripts.beautify:backend: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run prettier:write
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
